fields.description: Issue includes letters to the editor on overtaxation, tourism hospitality and policing, and municipal services in the southwest section; a continuing investigative editorial series criticizing the City of Miami–Miami Beach Railway bus agreement (profits, rate-setting, and long-term contract terms); reporting on oil drilling and speculative leases west of Miami on the Tamiami Trail; local commentary and humor columns; sports coverage (boxing, tennis, golf); society column by June Jasmine; and extensive local advertising and event notices (including Biscayne Fronton and nightclubs).
